Keywords: Lombard kin oaths and household fields

Variants.Content: Agelmund joins kin chiefs and followers. Oaths mobilize people without erasing family claims over fields, herds and rewards.

Agelmund joins kin chiefs and followers. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Shared oaths do not erase family claims over fields, herds and rewards.
Shared oaths do not erase family claims over fields, herds and rewards. Coordination allocates actual supply and protection duties, not merely titles. Agelmund joins kin chiefs and followers.
Agelmund joins kin chiefs and followers. Households compare burdens with neighbors; unmatched protection weakens cooperation. Shared oaths do not erase family claims over fields, herds and rewards.

Shared oaths do not erase family claims over fields, herds and rewards. One promise may not bind every receiver, guard and supplier; negotiation needs actual responsibility. Agelmund joins kin chiefs and followers.
